latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: multi-source album review aggregator with bias minimization. Two-pass search strategy (Wikipedia sweep + targeted deep dives). Covers 16 sources across 3 tiers (Pitchfork, AllMusic, NME, Rolling Stone, Metacritic, RateYourMusic, Douban, Sputnikmusic, etc.). Essay-style output with inline bias annotations, mandatory counterarguments, and epigraph opening. Supports Chinese, English, and custom language output.
